    solver.add(end - start >= friends[friend]["min_duration"])

        end = model[meeting_times[friend][1]].as_long()

            "start_time": f"{start // 60:02}:{start % 60:02}",

        })
    print({"itinerary": itinerary})
else:
    print("No solution found")
